Here we discuss our individual patient problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patient's clinical problems with collective current best evidence based inputs. This e-log book also reflects my patient centered online learning portfolio and your valuable comments in comment box are most welcomed\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI have been given this case to solve in an attempt to understand the topic of \"Patient clinical data analysis\" to develop my competency i reading and comprehending clinical data including history, clinical findings, investigations and come up with a diagnosis and treatment plan\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EChief complaints:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPain abdomen in the epigastric\u0026nbsp; region since 10 days\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EVomitings 5 days ago\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECold since 6 days\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECough since 5 days\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHOPI:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient came to OPD with\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EC\/O abdominal pain in the epigastric region since 10 days which is intermittent aggrevate on palpation and releived on medication and got check at rmp clinci then gave some medication and on fluids and releived then again on the same night he got another episode of similar type of pain and get admitted in suryapet and underwent investigations and diagnosed as pancreatitis and liver cirrhosis\u0026nbsp; and underwent treatment for 2 days and got discharged\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThere are 2 episodes of vomiting which is non projectile and non blood stained and content is food particles.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EComplaints of cold since 6 days and cough since 5 days which is dry type at beginning and came with expectorant after 3 days and there is shortness of\u0026nbsp; breath which is on rest\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPast history:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E7 years ago they went to hospital with complaints of pain in the loin region and decreased Urine output and went to hospital and diagnosed as renal calculi and taken medication and got relieved.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E3 years ago there pain in the right hand and tingling numbness along the right hand and went to hospital and diagnosed as cervical C3 C4 disc compression and underwent ayurvedic treatment for 15 days and got relieved.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPersonal history:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDiet mixed\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAppetite normal\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESleep adequate\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBowel and bladder regular\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHe is alcoholic since 15 years daily , 180ml\/ day and chewing of tobacco since 15 years ,1 packet \/day. Last alcohol on 5th Oct (binge alcohol for 1 week)\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENot a k\/c\/o HTN, DM, ASTHAMA, TB, EPILEPSY, CAD ,CVA.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EGeneral examination\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient is c\/c\/c\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo pallor, icterus, clubbing, cyanosis, lymphadenopathy, edema.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETemp-Afebrile\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBP- 110\/70\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPR - 80\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ERR - 18\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECVS - S1 S2 heard\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ER\/S - inspection\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Eshape - scaphoid\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo wheeze\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo scars , sinuses present.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPalpation:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Eno palpable mass,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrachea- central\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAuscultation:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EVesicular breath sounds\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Edecreased breath sounds in right infra scapular and infra axillary area\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo dyspnea, no rhonchi.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EP\/A -\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EInspection - obese abdomen, there are no scars ,sinuses , no distension, no eversion of umbilicus.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPalpation - girth - 113 cm\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETenderness on right iliac fossa, rt\u0026nbsp; lumbar region, rt hypochondrial epigastric region.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo palpable liver and spleen.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECNS - NFND\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; This e-log book also reflects my patient centered online learning portfolio and your valuable comments in comment box are most welcomed\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI have been given this case to solve in an attempt to understand the topic of \"Patient clinical data analysis\" to develop my competency i reading and comprehending clinical data including history, clinical findings, investigations and come up with a diagnosis and treatment plan\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EChief complaints:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPedal edema since 7 days\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDecreased Urine output 2 days\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESob grade 2 since 1 day\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EExcess sweating since 4hrs\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHOPI:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Ept was apparently asymptomatic 15 years back then he developed polyuria,polyphagia and diagnosed with DM,\u0026nbsp; then started on OHA. 5 yrs back pt developed weakness of rt upper and lower limb and diagnosed with hypertension and started on MET-XL 25mg.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENow since 7 days patient developed b\/l pedal edema , pitting type upto knee . Decreased Urine output since 2 days associated with burning micturation associated with urgency, hesitancy, and not associated with fever.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESob grade 2 gradual in onset since 1 days not associated with cough and chest pain .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EK\/c\/o DM SINCE 15YRS\u0026nbsp; on GLUCONORM\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EK\/C\/O HTN SINCE 5YRSBON MET-XL 25mg\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPersonal history:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDiet- mixed\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAppetite normal\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESleep adequate\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBLADDER - decreased Urine output\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBowel movements normal\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHe is occasional alcoholic since 35 yrs and 360ml\/day for 30 yrs and decreased to 180 ml\/day since 5 years.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EGeneral examination:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both;
